profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Instilled with a passion for bringing beauty and ideal user experience to the web. I strive to bring positive and unique ideas that will enhance the products and services that we provide

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Originally hired in my role at The Receptionist in August 2025, and continued in the same position after Sign In Solutions acquired The Receptionist in January 2026.

company.name: Sign In Solutions | Visitor Management System

positions.title: Freelance Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Redesigned and rebuilt WordPress website using Divi and custom PHP, creating modern components and improving overall user experience and site functionality.
• Optimized website performance, reducing load times by 500ms and improving caching efficiency through static CSS generation improvements.
• Collaborated with stakeholders to modernize their web presence while maintaining brand consistency and improving site maintainability.
positions.insights: Skills: WordPress · PHP · Project Management · Front-End Development

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description: Skills: Engineering Management · Project Management · React.js · Full-Stack Development · Ruby on Rails

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Migrated multiple Rails and Angular views to React, reducing code inconsistencies and enabling automated design system updates that helped accelerate feature development cycles.
• Contributed to establishing design tokens and reusable patterns that reduced UI development time and improved cross-product consistency across all shipped features.
• Collaborated on the improvement of an engineering mentorship program; served as both mentor and mentee to engineers across domains, helping improve engineer engagement and culture.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Using headless WordPress with a React front end, implemented Stripe platform integration, to help increase revenue according to our 6 month goal.

Led initiative to improve various design elements and features onto the platform to create better experience for users.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Shopify · WordPress · React.js · Project Management

positions.title: Front-End Developer
positions.description:
Collaborated with external clients, designers, and developers to define project scope and architecture for 5 successful web projects.

Implemented headless CMS with React, optimizing site performance and enabling seamless content updates for increased efficiency and flexibility.

Develop web applications from design, to test, to production deployment. Utilizing responsive web best practices to create consistent complete deliverables.
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · WordPress · PHP · Ruby on Rails · Project Management

positions.title: Certified Personal Trainer
positions.description:
•  Worked with new clients to complete assessments using the Functional Movement Systems (FMS) screen
•  Assisted members in setting goals, tracked and maintained progress
•  Planned and ran class workouts for members that included aerobic, kettlebell, TRX and strength exercises

positions.title: Technical Project Manager
positions.description:
Manage web development & design projects.
Create sitemaps for high-ranking SEO websites
Wireframe all website projects, instituting a user-centered design (UCD) approach.

positions.title: MDU Representative
positions.description:
•  Providing customer with technical solutions for their DIRECTV equipment. 
•  Coordinate with Research & Resolution and Tier 2 Technical Support teams on more complex issues.
•  Adhere to the highest levels of customer financial and personal data security.
•  Handle 20-40 customer calls/requests a day.

positions.title: Registration Consultant
positions.description:
•  Work directly with clients to plan on how to meet needs and goals for their registration systems
•  Organize, revise and update information on Sport Ngin websites and registrations
•  Build registration forms on the Sport Ngin platform for clients

positions.title: Content Specialist
positions.description:
•  Helped manage Buckeye CableSystem Sports Network (BCSN)/The Toledo Blade preps sports section, including schedules, rosters, scores, etc.
•  Used Sport Ngin Mass Score software to enter statistical data for variety of events, including Nike and Under Armour AAU basketball, baseball/softball, football, soccer and volleyball
•  Built hundreds of registration pages for Jr. League PGA camps, as well as developed league pages on the Sport Ngin platform

honors.title: Women Who Code Atlanta Hackathon Winner
honors.issuer: Issued by Women Who Code Atlanta · Oct 2017

honors.title: Code Switch Hackathon Winner
honors.issuer: Issued by Code Switch MN · Sep 2017

volunteerExperiences.description: Was selected by the current Black Student Union board members to be the Alumni Adviser for the upcoming school year. I will provide guidance and assistance to the board throughout the year when they have questions about student group processes, or have problems.
